units.source_text: 以前，我只在竹一面前不在乎暴露自己容易受傷的神經，所以放心地讓竹一看了我的自畫像，萬萬沒想到的是竟被他讚不絕口。

en.t: Before that, only in front of Takeichi had I not cared about exposing my easily wounded nerves, so I felt safe letting him see my self-portrait, never imagining that he would praise it so highly.

units.source_text: 於是，我又連續畫了兩三幅妖怪的畫像。

en.t: After that, I went on to draw two or three more portraits of monsters.

units.source_text: 竹一又送給我一個預言：「你會成為一名偉大的畫家。」

en.t: Takeichi then gave me another prophecy: "You will become a great painter."

units.source_text: 不久，扛著傻瓜竹一賦予我的「被迷戀」和「會成為一名偉大的畫家」這兩個預言，我來到了東京。

en.t: Before long, carrying the two prophecies that foolish Takeichi had bestowed on me, "being adored" and "becoming a great painter," I came to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我本來想上美術學校，可父親早打算讓我讀高中，以便日後從政當官。

en.t: I had wanted to attend art school, but my father had long planned for me to go to high school so that I could later enter politics and become an official.

units.source_text: 由於父親以前就吩咐過我，我也不敢頂嘴，只好茫然遵從。

en.t: Because my father had already ordered me to do so, I did not dare talk back and could only obey in a daze.
